questions.question: Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation. 55 * 63 * 9 * 8 * 3 = 38
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

55 * 63 * 9 * 8 * 3 = 38
questions.solution:
(4) +, ÷, -, ×

⇒ 55 * 63 * 9 * 8 * 3 = 38

After putting the signs:

⇒ 55 + 63 ÷ 9 - 8 × 3 = 38

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 55 + 7 - 8 × 3

⇒ 55 + 7 - 24

⇒ 62 - 24 = 38

⇒ '55 + 63 ÷ 9 - 8 × 3 = 38'

questions.question: If sec θ + tan θ = 5, then find the value of tan θ.
questions.questionHtml: If sec θ + tan θ = 5, then find the value of tan θ.
questions.solution:
sec θ + tan θ = 5  ----- (1) ; sec θ - tan θ = 1/5 ------- (2)

Subtracting the eq. (1) and (2)

⇒ (sec θ + tan θ) - (sec θ - tan θ) = (5 - 1/5) ⇒ sec θ + tan θ - sec θ + tan θ = 24/5 ⇒ 2 × tan θ = 24/5 ⇒ tan θ = 12/5

questions.question: The ratio of the length of each equal side and the third side of an isosceles triangle is 3 ∶ 5. If the area of the triangle is \(30\sqrt{11}\) cm 2 then the length of the third side (in cm) is:

questions.solution:
Area of isosceles triangle = (5x/4) × √{(4 × (3x)2) - (5x)2}

⇒ 30 × √11 = (5x/4) × √{(4 × 9x2) - 25x2} ⇒ 30 × √11 = (5x2/4) × √11 ⇒ x2/4 = 6 ⇒ x = √24  = 2√6

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 36?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 36?
questions.solution:
Number = 29412

The sum of digits = 2 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 2 = 18. 18 is divisible by 9. So the number is also divisible by 9.

The last two digits = 12. 12 is divisible by 4. So the number is divisible by 4.

29412 is divisible by 36.

questions.question: Amar can complete a work in 15 days, and Prem, in 12 days. Starting with Amar, they work on alternate days. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.questionHtml: Amar can complete a work in 15 days, and Prem, in 12 days. Starting with Amar, they work on alternate days. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
Efficiency Person Time Total work
4 Amar 15 60
5 Prem 12

(Amar + Prem) = 4 + 5 = 9 units = 2 days ⇒ 58 units = 13 days ⇒ 60 units = 13 + (2/5) = 13\(2\over5\) days

questions.solution:
Efficiency Person Time Total work
9 A 4 36
4 B 9

(B + A) = 4 + 9 = 13 units = 2 days ⇒ 30 units = 5 days ⇒ 36 units = 5 + (6/9) = 5\(2\over3\) days

questions.question: If (a + b + c) = 19 and (a 2 + b 2 + c 2 ) = 155, find the value of (a - b) 2 + (b - c) 2 + (c - a) 2 .
questions.questionHtml: If (a + b + c) = 19 and (a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup>) = 155, find the value of (a - b)<sup>2</sup> + (b - c)<sup>2</sup> + (c - a)<sup>2</sup>.
questions.solution:
a2 + b2 + c2 - (ab + bc + ca) = (1/2) × [(a - b)2 + (b - c)2 + (c - a)2]

⇒ 2 × (155 - 103) = (a - b)2 + (b - c)2 + (c - a)2

⇒ (a - b)2 + (b - c)2 + (c - a)2 = 104

questions.question: The difference (in Rs.) between a discount of 35% on Rs. 3,600 and two successive discounts of 30% and 5% on the same amount is:
questions.questionHtml: The difference (in Rs.) between a discount of 35% on Rs. 3,600 and two successive discounts of 30% and 5% on the same amount is:
questions.solution:
Discount (D1) = 3600 × 35% ⇒ 36 × 35 = Rs.1260

Effective discount = 30 + 5 - (30 × 5)/100 ⇒ 35 - 1.5 = 33.5%

Discount (D2) = 3600 × 33.5% = Rs.1206

Difference between two discount = (1260 - 1206) = Rs.54

questions.question: Raja and Rocky together can complete painting work In 5 days. Together they both start painting, but after 2 days, Rocky falls sick and leaves the work. If Raja completes the remaining painting in 4 days, find the number of days in which Rocky alone can do the work.
questions.questionHtml: Raja and Rocky together can complete painting work In 5 days. Together they both start painting, but after 2 days, Rocky falls sick and leaves the work. If Raja completes the remaining painting in 4 days, find the number of days in which Rocky alone can do the work.
questions.solution:
(Raja + Rocky) × 2 + Raja × 4 = (Raja + Rocky) × 5 ⇒ Raja × 4 = (Raja + Rocky) × 3 ⇒ Raja × 1 = Rocky × 3 ⇒ Raja/Rocky = 3/1

Total work = (Raja + Rocky) × 5 ⇒ (3 + 1) × 5 = 4 × 5 ⇒ 20 units

Time taken by Rocky alone to complete the painting work = 20/1 = 20 days

questions.question: To go a distance of 144 km upstream, a rower takes 12 hours while it takes her only 9 hours to row the same distance downstream. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.questionHtml: To go a distance of 144 km upstream, a rower takes 12 hours while it takes her only 9 hours to row the same distance downstream. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.solution:
Upstream speed of rover = (U - V) = 144/12 = 12 km/h ; Downstream speed of rover = (U + V) = 144/9 = 16 km/h

Speed of stream = (16 - 12)/2 = 4/2 = 2 km/h

questions.question: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 48 cm. Find its area (in cm 2 ).
questions.questionHtml: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 48 cm. Find its area (in cm<sup>2</sup>).
questions.solution:

Area of an equilateral triangle = {√3 × (side)2}/4 ⇒ {√3 × (16)2}/4 = 256√3/4 ⇒ 64√3 cm2

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. I fell / asleep while / I read / the book.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I fell / asleep while / I read / the book.
questions.solution: The use of the past tense in this phrase implies that the actions of dozing off and reading the book took place in the past. The past tense verb "fell" accurately expresses the activity of falling asleep. The adverb "asleep" describes the circumstances around the act of falling asleep. Because the word "read" is in the present tense while the remainder of the sentence is in the past tense, the phrase "I read" includes a grammatical mistake.

questions.question: Describe how you will tell your friends that Rohit helps Reghu in passive voice.
questions.questionHtml: Describe how you will tell your friends that Rohit helps Reghu in passive voice.

options.text: Reghu will been helped by Rohit.
options.html: Reghu will been helped by Rohit.

options.text: Reghu is being help by Rohit.
options.html: Reghu is being help by Rohit.

questions.solution: The topic of the passive sentence in passive voice is the object of the active sentence. Consequently, "Rohit helps Reghu" becomes "Reghu is helped by Rohit." Due to the passive voice and present tense of the sentence, the supporting word "is" is employed in addition to the primary verb "helped." Prior to the verb, the subject "Reghu" appears, while the doer "Rohit" is placed after the verb with the adverb "by."
